title: hydrocyclone operation
description: A hydrocyclone classifying a slurry on the case's size grid. Model declared: the case gives the corrected curve (with its cut size) and the water recovery to underflow R_f, which is also the solids bypass (Kelsall; Wills & Napier-Munn 2006 eq. 9.15): a_k = R_f + (1 - R_f) c_k. A dry feed is refused. Outputs (underflow overflow). The empirical correlation of Nageswararao et al. 2004 is not built.

partition.title: Partition curve (corrected)
partition.description: The corrected classification function c(d): the fraction of a size class that reports to the coarse product, before the bypass. whiten: c = 1 - (e^a - 1)/(e^(a d/d50c) + e^a - 2) (Nageswararao et al. 2004 eq. 21). rosinRammler: c = 1 - exp(-0.693 (d/d50)^m) (King 2001 eq. 4.41). tabulated: c_k declared class by class on the case's own grid, pan first.

d50.title: Cut size (rosinRammler)
d50.description: c(d50) = 0.49993 (King's constant 0.693 is kept as printed).

m.title: Sharpness m (rosinRammler)
m.description: King uses 5.9 for a vibrating screen.

corrected.title: Class values (tabulated)
corrected.description: Exactly one value per class of the case's size grid, the pan first, each in [0, 1].

waterToUnderflow.title: Water recovery to underflow R_f
waterToUnderflow.description: The fraction of the feed water leaving in the underflow; also the solids bypass.
